newsitem.title: USA: Panamsat says court affirms suit dismissal.
newsitem.headline: Panamsat says court affirms suit dismissal.

text.p: PanAmSat Corp said Monday the U.S. Court of Appeals affirmed the dismissal of its antitrust lawsuit against Comsat Corp.

PanAmSat said the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit affirmed on May 16 a lower court's refusal to consider evidence of Comsat's participation with other Intelsat owners in an anticompetitive boycott of PanAmSat.

The company said the refusal was based on what the lower court determined to be Comsat's immunity from U.S. antitrust laws due to its status as a partial owner of the treat-based Intelsat organization, which operates a global satellite system.
PanAmSat's original suit was filed in 1989.
